name: CKI
recent: CUCKOO International (MAL) Berhad 在2026年11月16日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，净利同比大增97.1%至2660万令吉，尽管营收走软。公司于10月1日宣布与四家独立销售伙伴合作扩大销售网络。此外，一名董事及主要股东在11月24日申报持股变动。
notable: 2026年第三季度净利同比大增97.1%至2660万令吉，营收同比走软。
公司于10月1日宣布与四家独立销售伙伴合作，以扩大销售网络。
一名董事及主要股东于11月24日申报持股变动。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为2.459亿令吉，环比增长7.9%，但同比下降19.8%；净利为2820万令吉，环比增长12.7%，同比增长3.2%；净利率为11.5%，高于上一季度的11.0%。

recent_en: CUCKOO International (MAL) Berhad reported on 16 November 2026 its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September, with net profit surging 97.1% year-on-year to RM26.6 million despite softer revenue. On 1 October, the company announced partnerships with four independent sales partners to expand its sales network. Separately, a director and substantial shareholder filed changes in interest on 24 November.
notable_en: 3Q26 net profit surged 97.1% year-on-year to RM26.6 million, while revenue softened year-on-year.
The company announced on 1 October partnerships with four independent sales partners to expand its sales network.
A director and substantial shareholder filed changes in interest on 24 November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM245.9 million, up 7.9% quarter-on-quarter but down 19.8% year-on-year; net profit was RM28.2 million, up 12.7% quarter-on-quarter and 3.2% year-on-year; net margin was 11.5%, up from 11.0% in the previous quarter.
